details:
Project Details – Spacecraft Repair Adventure

Spacecraft Repair Adventure is a 2D top-down space survival game developed using Godot 4. The player controls an astronaut who starts inside a destroyed spaceship. The main objective is to collect resources floating in space to earn points and repair the spaceship to escape.

The game includes three types of materials: scrap metal worth 1 point, asteroids worth 2 points, and gemstones worth 3 points. Players have a backpack with limited storage and a cable that limits how far they can travel from the spaceship. They can spend their points to upgrade both systems and explore farther. Players can also discover hidden planets containing valuable gemstones.

The main benefit of the project is that it encourages players to think strategically, manage limited resources, and plan their exploration. Its intended impact is to make space exploration more interesting while teaching the importance of resource management and problem-solving.

We used Godot 4 and GDScript to develop the game. The project is creative because it combines space exploration, survival, resource collection, and upgrades in one experience.

Our team considered important factors such as limited resources, exploration distance, backpack capacity, material values, and the difficulty of repairing the spaceship. These elements make the game challenging and encourage players to progress step by step.
